REST API for managing NetApp ONTAP storage systems. Provides programmatic access to cluster administration, storage provisioning, data protection, and networking configuration. The ONTAP REST API is available on all ONTAP 9.6 and later systems, with expanded coverage in each subsequent release. Resources include clusters, storage virtual machines (SVMs), aggregates, volumes, LUNs, snapshots, network interfaces, and more.
